lede.text: 2040 Fictional League leaders: the top ten in each category, your players marked

because.label: How to read it
because.value: The top ten in each batting and pitching category at the league's major league level this season, in order: highest first, and lowest first for earned run average and walks and hits per inning. The rate leaders count qualified players only; the counting leaders count everyone. Your organization's players are marked, and their club is named as yours.

basis.stamp: How the staff reads it: stated, not fitted

season.hint: The season the league's own data is in

qualifier.text: Rate leaders need 93+ plate appearances or 30+ innings

because.label: Hitters
because.value: 3.1 plate appearances for each game your club has played: 30 games make 93.

because.label: Pitchers
because.value: One inning for each game your club has played: 30 games make 30.

because.label: Which leaders
because.value: Batting average, on-base plus slugging, earned run average and walks and hits per inning count qualified players only; home runs, runs batted in, stolen bases, strikeouts, wins, saves and wins above replacement count everyone.
